In the second conversation dated 20260219_08:00, Adam Smith reminds Li Hua to pick up the key for the basement at 9 AM today. Therefore, it appears that the window measurements and the booking of the correct-sized curtains occurred earlier, specifically around October 12, 2026.

Since the second conversation (February 19, 2026) takes place significantly later, we can infer that the time interval between the initial request for window measurements and the booking of the correct-sized curtains is indeed more than 7 days.

Therefore, yes, the time interval between Adam asking Li Hua to measure the size of the window and Adam informing Li Hua that he has booked the curtain of the right size is more than 7 days.
